notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Karn Liberated has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn Liberated.
Activate Karn Liberated by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
